entities.summary: Per Wiberg (b. 1968-06-08, Stockholm) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Stockholm and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
